statement: Designer & researcher with 7+ years of turning gnarly problems into human-centred solutions. I come to every collaboration with genuine curiosity, informed experimentation, and the kind of thinking that connects dots across fields. If it challenges assumptions, connects disciplines, or helps real humans live better, I'm probably already thinking about it.
Let's create meaningful, systemic impact together.

entries.summary: Accessible healthcare-financing web app, serving 4 facilities and 1,800+ users.
description: Sole designer working from PM-defined acceptance criteria through to engineering handoff.
Redesigned the onboarding/signup flow, cutting median completion time from 5.2 minutes to 2.1 minutes (59% reduction).

Designed and shipped new engagement surfaces (Discovery/Explore, Profile Hub), each reaching 80+ monthly active users within four months of launch, as part of a platform that grew from 396 to 770 monthly active users over the same period.

Led Jireh Health’s frontend design-system modernization by introducing reusable primitives, semantic tokens, and consistent UI patterns to improve scalability and maintainability across B2C (mobile) and B2B (web) experiences.
Developed an in-house prototyping tool that mirrors the deployed frontend, effectively decoupling UX research and testing from backend dependencies and improving parallel workflows.

entries.summary: B2B fintech mobile app serving Kenyan micro and small enterprises (MSMEs).
description: Owned onboarding, referral, and transaction-flow design end-to-end: research, design, developer handoff, and iteration based on usage.
Designed for a low-bandwidth, non-technical, non-English-dominant user base.
Partnered directly with developers and product managers to ship designs to real users, then iterated based on usability testing and product feedback.
Formally led a 2-person design/research team on a dedicated initiative — assigning work and owning outcomes, while remaining hands-on in the craft.
Designed interactive prototypes for partnership presentations and product demos using Figma and the Adobe suite.
Championed accessibility and usability against W3C/WCAG 2.1 guidelines; produced clear design documentation to ease developer handoff.

description: Designed end-to-end UI/UX for a Congolese ride-hailing app, covering separate driver and passenger journeys.
Built a design system optimised for low-bandwidth conditions and entry-level Android devices.
Unified two distinct user mental models — driver and passenger — within a single navigation structure.
Prototyped an AI-powered e-learning platform under timed, competitive conditions for a global UX hiring assessment.
Applied end-to-end UX methodology — research synthesis, IA, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping — within a constrained timeline.

Trained and evaluated a U-Net segmentation model (5.78M parameters) for satellite land-cover classification, and built a complete Streamlit application around it: on-demand Sentinel-2 imagery retrieval, tiled inference, mask-based change detection, and geopandas-based intersection with protected-area boundaries on an interactive map; the full loop from raw imagery to a decision-ready interface.

Ran a rigorous domain-shift evaluation and found the model's accuracy collapsed when applied to real target-region imagery after training on a different geography; diagnosed the cause and scoped the fix, rather than shipping a plausible-looking but unreliable result.

Built and hyperparameter-tuned a CNN for satellite land-cover classification (EuroSAT benchmark, 10 classes), reaching 85% held-out accuracy; then built a geospatial pre-processing pipeline (rasterio, geopandas) to extend the same approach to a real, unlabelled region.

Trained a Random Forest classifier predicting IUCN Red List threat status for Kenya's Data-Deficient species (35,000+ records, 87.5% test accuracy, 90.1% cross-validated F1), including an explicit, self-authored limitations section on where the model's predictions should and shouldn't be trusted.

Built an interactive Tableau dashboard exploring electricity pricing, affordability, and the renewable-energy transition, synthesising government tariff schedules, household income data, and regional generation statistics.
Laid out a position paper for the official champions of the Paris Agreement, presented at the Summit of the Future 2024.
Adapted an existing Adobe InDesign template/styleguide under live content changes.
